ceterms:description.en-US: This course provides students with an overview of the data analytics process in accounting: asking appropriate accounting questions, finding and mastering appropriate accounting data to address those questions, performing test analysis and communicating the results of the data through data visualizations. Extensive hands-on, experiential learning using both traditional analytics software and GenAI to perform descriptive, diagnostic, predictive and prescriptive analytics is a key part of the course. Basic knowledge of Excel is recommended. Prerequisite: (Non-business majors: (ACCT 20203 with a grade of C or better) and (INEG 23104 or STAT 30133 with a grade of C or better)) or (Business majors: (ACCT 20203 with a grade of C or better) and (ISYS 10303 with a grade of C or better)). (Typically offered: Fall and Spring)
